name: Clinical mentor recruitment, Q4 2026
purpose: Invite UK doctors to host visiting medical students for short observership placements.
offer_facts: Placements last two to four weeks.
Mentors choose the dates and host one or two students at a time.
Students are in their clinical years of medical school.
Mentors receive an honorarium of £300 per placement.
The first step is a 15-minute call with no commitment.
